body:
[A10] Disclosed as GAP-19 by PR #218 (issue #216, round 3).

**Defect.** The link input `link_up_i` reaches only `KL_srp_domain`, `KL_srp_vlan` and `KL_srp_listener_fsm` (`hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv`). No LeaveAll state machine and no PeriodicTransmission state takes it.

- **LINK_DOWN (Flush!).** IEEE 802.1Q-2018 10.7.5.2 also signals leavealltimer! (10.7.5.22) to the LeaveAll state machine (Table 10-5). This engine signals none, in either participant.
- **LINK_UP (Begin!).** 10.7.5.1 initialises every state machine of the participant. For the LeaveAll machine (Table 10-5) and the PeriodicTransmission machine (Table 10-6) that would be a restarted timer. This engine restarts neither. Confirm against the clause text, or record why this half is not owed.

**Effect.** At most one early or late own LeaveAll, or periodic, after a link bounce. #216's acceptance kept the MRP timers unchanged, so #216 does not fix it.

**Done means.**
- Both link edges reach the LeaveAll and PeriodicTransmission machines as the clauses require, in both participants, each with a test and a plant.
- GAP-19's owner cell in `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` links this issue, and the row closes when the fix lands.
title: MRP: link edges do not reach the LeaveAll and PeriodicTransmission machines (802.1Q-2018 10.7.5.1, 10.7.5.2)
